tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find a place in Singapore by name, address or postal code. Returns the best matches with their distance.

query.description: What the user called the place, e.g. Northpoint, home, 768019

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Plan a trip from here to a place found by search_places, by walking, bus and MRT.

place_id.description: The id of a place from search_places

tools.name: start_navigation
tools.description: Start guiding the user along the trip just planned.

tools.name: nav_status
tools.description: Where the user is on the trip: the next step, distance and time left.

tools.name: nearby_bus_stops
tools.description: The bus stops nearest to the user.

tools.name: services_at_stop
tools.description: The bus services that call at a bus stop.

stop.description: 5-digit bus stop code or stop name; empty = the nearest stop

tools.name: bus_arrivals
tools.description: When the next buses come at a bus stop. When the user names a bus number (858, 969, 39...), always pass it as service.

service.description: The bus number the user said, e.g. 858 or 969; leave out only if they named no bus

stop.description: 5-digit bus stop code; empty = the nearest stop

tools.name: gps_accuracy
tools.description: How accurate the user's GPS position is right now.

tools.name: set_mode
tools.description: Ask to switch Cortex's mode, e.g. EXPLORE to describe the surroundings, INDOOR_NAV when the user says they are inside.

tools.name: camera
tools.description: Turn the camera on or off.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Where the user last left one of their things (keys, wallet, phone, glasses, bag, cane, or an item they added in the app): the spot, place and how long ago it was seen.

item.description: The thing the user asked about, e.g. keys or water bottle
